Title: Bulk delete via header checkbox
Preconditions: Two owned "e2e_" users are created by this test on the current run. The Username search filter is EXACT-MATCH ONLY (live-observed 2026-09-25, not a substring/contains filter as originally assumed), so narrowing the list to show both new users at once via a shared partial-string search is not possible on this build; the unfiltered list sorts alphabetically, so two users sharing a literal e2e_ prefix land adjacent to each other on the same page instead.
Test_Steps:
1. Navigate to the unfiltered System Users list
2. Walk pagination pages (if any) until the page containing both owned users is found
3. Select both rows via their row checkboxes (click the .oxd-checkbox-wrapper label, not the raw input)
4. Click "Delete Selected"
5. Confirm the dialog
6. Verify each specific username individually via its own exact-match search — never an unfiltered total-record-count delta, which is vulnerable to concurrent real users on this shared demo
Expected_Result: Header bar shows "(2) Records Selected"; the confirm dialog uses the identical singular wording as single-delete (FIND-003, not pluralised); after confirming, each of the two specifically-created users is individually confirmed absent from the list via its own exact-match search (live-redesigned 2026-09-25 — the original "record count decreases by 2" assertion was dropped as unreliable on a shared demo where concurrent real users independently change the total count).
